title: GooseSoopMC
description: A little group for people who'd like to play Minecraft, whether on Bedrock or Java, everyone can join!
body:
# GooseSoopMC
A server dedicated to community and openness regardless of where you come from, as long as you're welcoming to others, you'll be welcomed back with open arms. Griefing, saying or suggesting slurs, or destroying others hard work for the "Fun of it" is not allowed and you will get banned for doing such things.

LGBTQ+ Owned and maintained. Most community members are of some sort of LGBTQ+ identity, any discrimination or hatespeech is non-tolerated and you will get banned.

---

### Server Info:
**Java:** vanilla.goosesoop.com

**Bedrock:** bedrock.goosesoop.com
Port: 4282
##### Server Version: 26.2
###### Any client version can join
Live Map: [http://map.vanilla.goosesoop.com:8123](http://map.vanilla.goosesoop.com:8123/#e_survival_survival:-173:59:94:83:0:0:0:1:flat)

---
### Cross-Play Support
Java and Bedrock players are able to play together

Console support (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch)

Add “GooseSoopMC” on Xbox to be able to join on consoles

Optional Bedrock ↔ Java account linking if you cross play between accounts

---
### Gameplay

Survival-focused experience

Quality-of-life improvements

Multi-world support

---
### Features

Live web map

Optional proxy voice chat (Simple Voice Chat)

Discord integration (Discord chat bridge)

Teleport requests (TPA)

Death location tracking

Custom join & death messages
